title: Mitigating Language-Level Performance Disparity in mPLMs via Teacher Language Selection and Cross-lingual Self-Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance disparity and cross-lingual transfer gaps between high-resource languages (e.g., English) and low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili) across multilingual Natural Language Understanding (NLU) benchmarks like XNLI, PAWS-X, and XCOPA, as well as probing language-specific knowledge using the GeoMLAMA dataset.
